name: Solar neighbourhood stand-in (until G0's default patch envelope lands)
references: [Fe/H]: Casagrande et al. 2011, A&A 530, A138 (Geneva-Copenhagen survey re-analysis: mean -0.05, spread about 0.2 dex)
Ages: roughly flat star formation history of the thin disc over 10 Gyr (Binney, Dehnen and Bertelli 2000, MNRAS 318, 658)
C/O 0.47 and Mg/Si 1.02 with their spreads: Brewer and Fischer 2016, ApJ 831, 20
26Al: Lichtenberg et al. 2016, Icarus 274, 350 (enrichment spread; the Solar System sits high in it)
Cluster members: embedded-cluster mass function dN/dM ~ M^-2 (Lada and Lada 2003, ARA&A 41, 57)
FUV field at discs: Fatuzzo and Adams 2008, ApJ 675, 1361 (median about 1000 G0, broad)
